# Bundled dependency notices

These files reproduce LICENSE, NOTICE, COPYING and COPYRIGHT documents from
the exact dependency packages used by the bundled DeepSteam, OpenMAIC and
video renderer runtimes. They supplement the upstream application licenses
and notices preserved one directory above, and the Python, Node and FFmpeg
license documents retained beside those bundled runtimes.

`NOTICE-INVENTORY.json` records the source package name, version, relative
installed path and SHA256 of each copied notice. Some packages place their
notice inline in source or do not ship a separate root notice; those are
listed separately rather than reported as verified license documents.

The official Chromium root license matches the bundled Chrome for Testing
version. The original browser `ABOUT` remains alongside the browser; its
`chrome://credits` and `chrome://terms` pages contain further browser notices
and terms. The Chromium root license is not a replacement for those pages.

FFmpeg is the Gyan essentials GPLv3 build, with its original LICENSE, README,
build configuration, pinned source commit link and download provenance in
`runtime/ffmpeg`. This inventory documents retained notices and provenance;
it is not a certification of compliance for every possible distribution.

No personal account state, user learning records or API credentials are part
of this notice collection. All runtime settings are initialized on the
recipient's computer.
